clue.text: Travel with ship to a foreign sea, for fine material

parts.note: to travel is to go
SS is the abbreviation for steamship
mer is the French word for sea

explanation.surface: A sea voyage abroad undertaken in search of delicate fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Gossamer is a very light, sheer fabric, or the fine cobweb threads it is named after.

clue.text: Musical work for many performers, or a small group? Nothing in it

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: 'in it' tells us to place the zero inside the small group just named

parts.note: a trio is a small group of three, here with its article A
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A question of whether a piece needs a big cast or just a little band, with nothing in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nothing in it' puts O inside A TRIO, giving ATORIO after OR.
explanation.definitionFit: An oratorio is a large-scale choral and orchestral composition, typically on a sacred theme.

clue.text: Division, for example, with soldiers In position

indicators.note: 'In' tells us the example and soldiers go inside the word for position

parts.note: a station is a post or position
EG is the abbreviation of exempli gratia, for example
soldiers are men

explanation.surface: An army division, for instance, with its troops deployed in their posts.
explanation.definitionFit: Segmentation is the act of splitting something into parts, a dividing up.

clue.text: A wizard with words surely shouldn't

definitions.text: A wizard with words surely shouldn't

parts.words: A wizard with words surely shouldn't
parts.note: read as a writer, someone good with words should never get spelling wrong; read literally, a wizard's spells ought not to go awry

explanation.surface: Someone eloquent ought never to make that slip.
explanation.definitionFit: To get the letters of a word wrong is the error a skilled wordsmith should avoid; a sorcerer's botched incantation is the punning second sense.

clue.text: How to make a new man of Noel? Just the opposite

definitions.text: How to make a new man of Noel?
definitions.meaning: turning the name Noel back to front gives Leon, a different man's name
the contrary or converse of something

explanation.surface: A riddle about transforming a man called Noel, with the answer that it is the contrary.
explanation.definitionFit: Spelling Noel backwards makes Leon, a different man; and the word also means contrary or converse.

clue.text: Pharaoh embarrassed by main obstacle to his pursuit

parts.note: an embarrassed person goes red
the main is a poetic term for the sea

explanation.surface: An Egyptian king humiliated when the waters block his chase.
explanation.walkthrough: In Exodus the waters parted for the Israelites and closed over the pursuing Egyptian army, so the sea was the king's obstacle.
explanation.definitionFit: The Biblical sea that blocked the Egyptian chariots chasing Moses and the Israelites.

clue.text: Old ship has unloaded first part of freight

indicators.note: unloading the first part means the opening letter of the word for freight is dropped

parts.note: a cargo is freight carried by a ship

explanation.surface: An ancient vessel has taken off the first portion of its goods.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary vessel of Jason and the Argonauts in Greek myth.

clue.text: Put on view or not?

parts.note: the word can mean shown, as a film in a cinema, or its opposite, hidden behind a partition

explanation.surface: A question of whether something was displayed or kept out of sight.
explanation.definitionFit: A film shown in cinemas has been shown publicly, yet something behind a partition is hidden: one word, contrary senses.

clue.text: Liable to shock, being sort of blue

definitions.meaning: carrying a current that can give a jolt
a vivid steely blue shade has this name

explanation.surface: Something dangerous to touch that also has a bright azure colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Live wiring can give a jolt; and a brilliant steely shade of azure bears the same name.

clue.text: A lot of criminals go north of the border

definitions.meaning: in Scots dialect, spoken north of the English border, the verb meaning to go

explanation.surface: Many crooks heading up into Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'North of the border' means in Scotland, where the dialect word for go is used.
explanation.definitionFit: A mob is a band of crooks; and the Scots dialect verb for walk or go.

clue.text: Skilful act from captain and member of crew

parts.note: the master is the captain of a merchant ship
in a rowing crew the stroke is the oarsman who sets the pace

explanation.surface: A feat of skill performed by a ship's skipper and one of his sailors.
explanation.definitionFit: A brilliantly clever move or coup.

clue.text: Its students are up .most of the time

definitions.text: Its students are up .most of the time

parts.words: Its students are up .most of the time
parts.note: sounds like pupils who stay awake late, but they are up in the saddle on horseback

explanation.surface: A college whose pupils never seem to go to bed.
explanation.definitionFit: An establishment where pupils learn horsemanship, spending lessons mounted.

clue.text: Omit nothing in settling foreign border

indicators.note: settling suggests letters falling into a new arrangement
omit tells us to drop a letter from the word foreign

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Advice to leave nothing out when sorting a frontier abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Omit nothing' removes O from FOREIGN to leave FREIGN; 'settling' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A fringe is an edge or margin, the outer boundary of something.

clue.text: Deputizes for one who's good and evil

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for saint, a holy and good person
taken as written
sin is wickedness

explanation.surface: Someone substitutes for a person of mixed morals.
explanation.definitionFit: To substitute or act as replacement for another person.

clue.text: Medical congress? In a way that's right

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, an army doctor
a rally is a large gathering or meeting

explanation.surface: A conference of doctors, judged on whether it behaved properly.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting ethically means acting in accordance with what is right.

clue.text: It's to show what's carried by tradesman if 'e's truthful

indicators.note: the run of letters is carried within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A cockney shopkeeper who is honest will demonstrate it.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'e is the dropped-h cockney 'he'; the apostrophes are ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: To manifest something is to display it plainly or make it evident.

clue.text: Artist taking a road, right ? Left German city

parts.note: Bonn, the former West German capital

explanation.surface: A painter goes along a road, turns right, and leaves a German city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' puts the German city at the left, and the clue's 'taking a road, right' sets A and RD to its right.
explanation.definitionFit: Pierre Bonnard was a French post-impressionist painter.

clue.text: Grandfather clock ?

parts.note: read as an elderly timekeeper, a joking description of a veteran, an elderly man who has been around a long while

explanation.surface: A tall pendulum timepiece.
explanation.definitionFit: A veteran or elderly person; and, punningly, an aged timepiece.

clue.text: Disparages what this answer ..does

definitions.meaning: as a Down entry, the word travels downwards in the grid

explanation.surface: A remark that criticizes, and also describes the grid entry itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Belittling someone is talking them down; and a Down light literally goes from top to bottom.

clue.text: No longer sitting? Like defeated MP…

definitions.meaning: removed from the throne, so no longer seated on it
an MP who loses their seat has been ousted

explanation.surface: A question about someone standing up, likened to a politician beaten at the polls.
explanation.definitionFit: A dethroned monarch is no longer seated on the throne; an ousted politician has been removed from office.

clue.text: To name, in another way

indicators.note: another way of ordering the letters, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A suggestion for saying 'to name' differently.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of TO NAME IN, put in another way, make the answer, which itself means to name: the whole clue is both definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To put forward or designate someone, to propose by name.

clue.text: … has ten constituents in the city

indicators.note: the constituents, or component letters, are taken apart and reassembled

explanation.surface: A metropolis with ten electoral parts.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links it to 19 down, but the clue works alone.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek capital.

clue.text: Acting to contain onset of sickness

definitions.text: Acting to contain onset of sickness

indicators.note: 'to contain' says the word for acting holds the first letter inside it

parts.note: doing is acting or performing

indicators.note: the onset is the start, the first letter

explanation.surface: Taking measures to keep an illness from spreading.
explanation.walkthrough: S, the first letter of 'sickness', goes inside DOING; the whole clue also describes giving medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: Administering medicine is a way of fighting illness at its start.

clue.text: Nationalities producing Finnish, so to speak

parts.note: French is a nationality
Polish is another nationality

explanation.surface: Two national groups combining to produce a Finnish one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Finnish, so to speak' is 'finish' said aloud: the answer is a glossy wood finish of shellac.
explanation.definitionFit: A shellac varnish applied to give wood a high-gloss surface coating.

clue.text: Associated with soles in Billingsgate

indicators.note: Billingsgate fish porters speak cockney, which drops the initial H

parts.note: heels go with soles on shoes

explanation.surface: Fish sold next to flatfish at the London market.
explanation.walkthrough: Billingsgate is London's fish market, where these fish are sold beside soles; cockney speech there drops H.
explanation.definitionFit: Snake-like fish, a London staple sold at the market alongside flatfish.

clue.text: Old coin-a noble? Casual listener might think so

indicators.note: someone half-listening could mishear one phrase as a similar-sounding one

parts.note: a noble was an old English gold coin

explanation.surface: Asking whether an ancient coin is a noble.
explanation.walkthrough: Said quickly, 'a noble' sounds like 'an obol'; the noble was itself an old coin.
explanation.definitionFit: A silver coin of ancient Greece, worth a sixth of a drachma.

clue.text: Brew nice ales of outstanding quality

indicators.note: to brew is to mix up, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to make some fine beers of exceptional merit.
explanation.definitionFit: Prominence: the quality of standing out or being noticeable.

clue.text: King embraced by sweetheart — not in daylight

indicators.note: being embraced means held inside the other word

parts.note: a darling is a beloved person
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A monarch hugged by his beloved after dark.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetic word meaning in the dark or gloom.
